## The task

<!-- Is the ground truth correct? Is each item well described, with one defensible answer?

item. Cite items by id. -->

## The grader

<!-- Does it credit only correct answers? Does it reject correct ones? Is it stable:

## The harness and environment

<!-- Configured as the paper and code say (versions, tools, network, data present)? Fair

there: web access, stale state, answer files? Did the environment break attempts? -->

## Aggregation and limits

<!-- What was excluded before the headline number, and why? Do turn, token or time limits

a ceiling from broken items, statistical power? Attempted and completed populations. -->
